overview: A cute pastel school start page with time-based greetings, live date/time, and quick-access links to all your school tools including Microsoft Office, Google apps, study tools, and social media — dark mode only with soft glowing accents.
features: Filter tabs to show only school apps or all apps
App icon cards for Microsoft, Google, Study, and Social tools
Real app favicons for all 16+ shortcuts
Soft pastel glows with dark background
